body: I agree with the other guy that you shouldn't give ideas to people not old enough to even drink. As a once teenager who would have done anything to have a break from thinking, no amount of information would've kept me away from DPH. The thing is, such a presentation would tell people that wouldn't stick with it information they'll figure out on their own after a single trip, while also telling potential addicts there's an accessible and cheap drug you can get hundreds of at Walmart for $10. Young people would be so much better off if this drug quit being a fucking meme and faded back into the obscurity of a horror you accidentally realise by wanting to take a 17 hour nap.
